stories.title: Gemeenteraad Terneuzen stemt in met vergunning voor asielzoekerscentrum

en.title: Terneuzen municipal council approves permit for asylum seeker center
en.summary: The Terneuzen municipal council approved a permit for an asylum seeker center after extended debate. The revised proposal, which focuses on family accommodations, passed with narrow support from opposition parties.

stories.title: Gemeenteraad Terneuzen stemt na lange politieke strijd toch in met komst azc

en.title: Terneuzen municipal council approves asylum seeker center after prolonged political struggle
en.summary: The Terneuzen council narrowly approved a permit for an asylum seeker center in a converted office building. Local residents indicate they plan to appeal the decision in court.

stories.title: Pentagon wil executie Nidal Hasan door vuurpeloton live uitzenden

en.title: Pentagon wants to livestream execution of Nidal Hasan by firing squad
en.summary: The U.S. Department of Defense plans to livestream the execution of a former military psychiatrist scheduled for December 3rd. This would mark the first public execution in the United States in ninety years.

stories.title: VS gaan executie van militair door vuurpeloton live uitzenden

en.title: U.S. to livestream execution of military officer by firing squad
en.summary: The United States plans to livestream the execution of a military officer by firing squad.

stories.title: Pentagon gaat executie van Fort Hood-schutter door vuurpeloton livestreamen

en.title: Pentagon to livestream execution of Fort Hood shooter by firing squad
en.summary: U.S. Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth announced that the firing squad execution of shooter Nidal Hasan will be publicly accessible via livestream. Hasan killed thirteen military personnel at Fort Hood in 2009.

stories.title: Raad Terneuzen stemt na lang debat toch in met vergunning voor azc

en.title: Terneuzen council approves permit for asylum center after lengthy debate
en.summary: The municipal council in Terneuzen voted in favor of granting a permit for an asylum center following extended discussion.

stories.title: SBS6-programma De Bondgenoten wint Gouden Televizier-Ring

en.title: SBS6 program De Bondgenoten wins Golden Television Ring
en.summary: The daily reality game show won the prestigious television award, defeating competitors Kassa and Woeste Grond. Presenter Jan Versteegh also received the Golden Television Ring for Best Presenter.

stories.title: Realityprogramma De Bondgenoten wint Gouden Televizier-Ring 2026

en.title: Reality program De Bondgenoten wins Golden Television Ring 2026
en.summary: The reality television program De Bondgenoten received the Golden Television Ring award for 2026.

stories.title: Dit zijn alle winnaars van het Gouden Televizier-Ring Gala 2026

en.title: These are all the winners of the Golden Television Ring Gala 2026
en.summary: Multiple awards were presented across various categories at the Golden Television Ring Gala held at the Royal Theatre Carré in Amsterdam, with NU.nl providing a complete list of all winners.

stories.title: Gouden Televizier-Ring voor De Bondgenoten, presentator Jan Versteegh wint ook

en.title: Golden Televizier-Ring awarded to De Bondgenoten, presenter Jan Versteegh also wins
en.summary: The SBS6 reality competition series De Bondgenoten won the Golden Televizier-Ring 2026, the Dutch viewer's choice award. Presenter Jan Versteegh also won the award for best presenter, while Annet Malherbe won best actor.

stories.title: Bondgenoten grote winnaar bij Gouden Televizier-Ring, ook Jan Versteegh wint

en.title: Bondgenoten major winner at Golden Televizier-Ring, Jan Versteegh also wins
en.summary: Reality program De Bondgenoten won the Golden Televizier-Ring award. Jan Versteegh won best presenter, Annet Malherbe won best actor, and Daan Alferink won the television talent award.

stories.title: Teruglezen | De Bondgenoten wint Gouden Televizier-Ring, Annet Malherbe beste acteur

en.title: Live coverage | The Allies wins Golden Television Ring, Annet Malherbe best actor
en.summary: The 2026 Golden Television Ring Gala awards ceremony took place, with The Allies winning the main prize and Annet Malherbe receiving the best actor award.
